finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_141_numeric_library_corr80_component_balanced_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.hypothetical_formula: Fit training-only positive-correlation connected components at a fixed +0.8 boundary, average favorable percentiles within each component, then average components equally while retaining all 141 factors.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign134 already froze and ran this exact complete-library positive-correlation component-balancing family at +0.8. It failed fold-one prefit uniqueness at absolute median daily rank correlation 0.8180313718344464 to the 66-factor arithmetic consensus before validation returns. Appending the later 141st comparator does not authorize a retry, new threshold, new linkage or refreshed graph.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.parameters: one complete semantic partition of all 141 factors

selection.reason: All three complete-library proposals refresh consumed aggregation families, both temporal or peer proposals recombine terminal operators and one violates a one-factor source contract, and the transaction-price proposal changes a previously exposed weighting or center choice.

decision.next_campaign_requirement: Continue only from a genuinely new finite mechanism supported by an accepted historically versioned point-in-time source whose original collection contract permits the use, or obtain explicit authorization for a separately frozen source-admission campaign.
